Downstream breaking changes 1

high

Generated SDK method moves between clients

The REST contracts are unchanged, but extending four client-location customizations to Go can move bmsPrepareDataMove, bmsTriggerDataMove, getOperationStatus, and moveRecoveryPoint between generated clients. Existing Go code that constructs the former clients or invokes these methods through them can stop compiling.

Evidence: All four @@clientLocation rules add Go to the language exclusion.; The four HTTP operation contracts remain unchanged.

Semantic intents 2

1✏️⚠️ Apply established client placement to four Go operations 4 operations

The client-location customizations extend the existing language-specific placement behavior to Go for bmsPrepareDataMove, bmsTriggerDataMove, getOperationStatus, and moveRecoveryPoint. These four methods can move to different generated Go clients, while their HTTP methods, paths, parameters, payloads, and responses remain unchanged.

API surface: 4 existing operations affected

ChangeAspectBeforeAfterImpact
✏️ Modified Go client location The four methods follow the prior language exclusions and generated Go client placement. Go is added to all four client-location exclusions, moving the methods to their established generated Go clients.
Generated SDK method moves between clientsClient customizations are not located in client.tsp

2Publish the inherited Recovery Services Backup surface in stable 2026-02-01 1 model properties

Seven existing Recovery Services Backup operations are published under the new stable 2026-02-01 API version. Their HTTP methods, paths, parameters, requests, responses, LRO behavior, and paging behavior are inherited without change.

API surface: Three model properties are added. Operations using those models expose the new fields, but the 7-operation version-lineage inventory is not a direct-impact count.

ChangeAspectBeforeAfterImpact

—

Source: main.tsp:L62-L71, main.tsp:L66-L70
